_about: Outside sources of vehicle, cycle, cell, motor, tyre and track data that
LightSim has looked at, each in one of three classes (BIZ-34):
BUNDLE       its data may ship in the installer, with the credit it asks for;
USER-IMPORT  never bundled: the user may fetch or import it themselves, on
their own terms with its owner (share-alike, EUPL, no licence,
LEARN        read it to learn the method, copy nothing (GPL/LGPL code,
backend/tests/test_data_register.py fails when a BUNDLE source's licence is
not in data-allowed.txt, and when a shipped row of docs/data-register.csv
names a USER-IMPORT or LEARN source (any 'match' text in its 'source' column).
'checked' says where the licence was read; re-check it before data from the
source first ships. Add a source here before its data reaches a pull request.
